title: Corpse Party: Blood Covered
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Before one classmate transfers away, a group of Kisaragi Academy students perform a friendship charm found online and are pulled into the ruins of Tenjin Elementary, a school razed after disappearances and murders, where earlier victims' ghosts and corpses remain. Trapped across intersecting realities, they must uncover the tragic past of the ghost Sachiko while the 'Darkness' turns them against each other (ANN review; MangaUpdates; Yen Press blurb via AniList).
life_message: Friendship is tested to breaking point by fear, and meddling with curses has deadly consequences.

folkways.japan: Draws on Japanese school ghost stories (gakkou no kaidan) and onryou, vengeful spirits bound by grudges, with classmates' group loyalty tested.

delivery.evidence: ANN treats it as a splatter horror adaptation with no stated message; themes carried by plot.
delivery.note: Any lesson about tampering with curses is implied by what happens to the students.

winners_losers: Few winners: friends die or break under the curse, and the ghosts' grudges drive events. Outcome of the final volumes not checked.
to_verify: ANN reviewed volume 1 only; later-volume gore and deaths not confirmed beyond database tags.
